Artist and designer Kleinian creates what he calls “Modern Archaeology”: physical artifacts that imagine how today’s digital culture might survive thousands of years into the future.  He takes real stones and transfers familiar digital images onto them (Artvangarde)smartphone interfaces, Google Maps, Spotify, video games and computer screens. The surfaces are then distressed and sealed, making recent technology look like something excavated from an ancient site.  The contrast is deliberate. Digital technology becomes obsolete incredibly quickly, while stone can survive for millennia. By turning pixels into apparent fossils, Kleinian asks a fascinating question: What would future archaeologists understand about us from the technology we leave behind? #art #artist #avantgarde #design #niche

Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Glossy Honey Garlic Chicken A quick and simply delicious meal to make - juicy seared criss crossed chicken breasts lacquered in a glossy honey garlic sauce. Served over creamy buttery mash and a side of crispy lightly seasoned green beans. Enjoy and follow along for more - @marisakapeal 🙏🏼♥️ Chicken (for 2 large breasts sliced in halves) * 2 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts, sliced in halves and criss crossed with a knife) * 1 tsp salt * ½ tsp black pepper * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * ½ tsp paprika * 1½ tbsp olive oil * 1 tbsp butter Green beans * 2 cups green beans washed and trimmed * Salt and pepper to taste  * Drizzle of olive oil and splash of water  Honey Garlic Sauce * ½ cup honey * 1½ cups chicken broth * 1 tsp dark soy sauce * 2 tbsps low sodium soy sauce  * 6–8 garlic cloves, finely grated or minced * 1 tbsp rice vinegar or apple cider vinegar * ½ tsp black pepper * Pinch red pepper flakes, optional * 1½ tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp cold water * 2 tbsp cold butter, for finishing Mash: 6-8 yukon gold potatoes peeled and rinsed  1/4-1/2 cups heavy cream room temperature 1/2 cup unsalted butter, room temperature  Salt and pepper to taste  	1.	Marinate chicken: Slice chicken breasts in half horizontally into 4 thinner cutlets. Lightly score in a crisscross pattern, then coat with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder and paprika. 	2.	Mashed potatoes: Peel and rinse 6–8 Yukon Gold potatoes. Boil in heavily salted water until fork-tender. Drain and steam-dry for 10 minutes, then mash with ½ cup softened butter, ¼–½ cup heavy cream, and salt and pepper until smooth and creamy. 	3.	Sear chicken: Heat a little olive oil and butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken for 1–2 minutes per side until golden, then remove. Chicken will finish cooking in the sauce. 	4.	Honey garlic sauce: In the same skillet, sauté garlic for 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, honey, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, vinegar and red pepper flakes. Simmer briefly, then gradually stir in cornstarch slurry until slightly thickened. 	5.	Finish chicken: Return chicken to the sauce and simmer, spooning sauce over top, until cooked through (165°F). Remove from heat and swirl in 1–2 tbsp cold butter for a rich, glossy finish. 	6.	Green beans: Sauté green beans with a splash of olive oil and water. Season lightly with salt and pepper and cook for a few minutes until tender-crisp. #honeygarlic #kitchen #cooking #explore #recipe

videos.caption: Chicken Alfredo Tortellini Soup This soup is an easy one-pot dinner that’s perfect for a cozy night!  Ingredients 1 lb chicken breast, cubed 2 tbsp butter 1 sweet onion, diced 3 large carrots, diced Salt and black pepper, to taste 1 tsp garlic powder 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 4 cups chicken stock 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half 18 oz cheese tortellini 1 (6 oz) bag shredded Parmesan cheese 3 cups fresh spinach 1 tsp crushed red pepper flakes Directions 1. Melt the butter in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion and carrots. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and poultry seasoning. Cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to soften. 2. Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and stir well until everything is evenly coated. Cook for 1–2 minutes. 3. Slowly pour in the chicken stock, stirring continuously to incorporate the flour and create a smooth broth. 4. Add the cubed chicken breast and bring the broth to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until the chicken is cooked through.  5. Stir in the heavy cream or half-and-half, followed by the cheese tortellini. Cook according to the package directions until the tortellini are tender. 6. Reduce the heat to low and gradually stir in the shredded Parmesan cheese until melted and the soup is creamy. 7. Add the fresh spinach and crushed red pepper flakes. Stir for 1–2 minutes, or until the spinach is wilted. 8. Remove from the heat and let the soup sit for about 10–15 minutes before serving. This gives the soup time to thicken and allows all those flavors to come together. Serve warm with extra Parmesan and crushed red pepper on top! Recipe Note The tortellini will continue to soak up the broth as the soup sits, so don't worry if it initially looks a little thinner than you'd like. It will thicken considerably as it rests. If you have leftovers, the tortellini will continue absorbing liquid overnight in the refrigerator. When reheating, simply add a splash of chicken stock, milk, half-and-half, or cream to loosen the soup back up to your desired consistency. #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #soupseason #easydinner #quickrecipes

videos.caption: VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Lemon Chicken Just Got an Upgrade 🍋🧄 This is one of our favorite dinners to make during the week and it’s going to be yours too. Lemon Garlic Chicken with Cherry Tomatoes has a little bit of everything to please anyone. I think this one really takes lemon chicken to the next level with the chili pepper garlic and tomato for a quick one pan meal that just tastes good every single time. Ingredients: 1 lb Thinly sliced chicken breast filets 1 cup Cherry tomatoes (halved) 3 cloves Garlic (chopped) 1/4 cup White wine Juice of 1 lemon Flour Olive Oil Salt and Pepper Chili pepper Knob of butter Chopped parsley Directions:  1. You have to try this Mississippi Chicken Casserole! i have fallen in love with the Mississippi Chicken Casserole! ❤️🐓😘 Ingredients Chicken Mixture * 1 block (8 oz) cream cheese, softened * ½ cup sour cream * ¼ cup melted butter * 1 cup whole milk * ¼ cup pepperoncini brine * 1 packet au jus seasoning * 1 packet ranch dressing mix * ¼ cup chicken broth * 2 cups shredded Monterey Jack & cheddar cheese * 3 cups shredded chicken * 1 cup chopped pepperoncinis For Sautéing Chicken (optional) * 2 tablespoons butter * ¼ cup chopped yellow onion * 1 tablespoon smoked paprika * 1 teaspoon onion powder * 1 teaspoon garlic powder Pasta Layer * 1 (12 oz) bag wide egg noodles * Chicken broth (for boiling noodles) Topping * At least 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack & cheddar cheese Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a 9×13 baking dish. 2. Cook noodles: Boil the egg noodles in chicken broth according to package directions. Drain and spread evenly in the baking dish. 3. Season the chicken (optional): In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add shredded chicken, chopped onion, smoked paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Cook about 5 minutes, stirring to coat and warm through. 4. Make the sauce: In a large bowl, mix cream cheese, sour cream, melted butter, milk, pepperoncini brine, au jus packet, ranch packet, and chicken broth until smooth. 5. Combine the filling: Stir the chicken, chopped pepperoncinis, and 2 cups of shredded cheese into the sauce until fully combined. 6. Assemble: Pour the chicken mixture over the noodles. Gently fold together—doesn’t need to be perfectly mixed. 7. Top: Sprinkle at least 1 cup shredded cheese evenly over the top. 8. Bake: Bake uncovered for 25–30 minutes, until bubbly and lightly golden. 9. Rest & serve: Let sit 5 minutes before serving. How to build an AI employee that works while you sleep. An AI agent is just a loop (goal → step → check → repeat) that can reach for tools. On its own it hits a wall: it forgets everything, waits for you, owns nothing. The ladder that turns it into staff: • ① context — files YOU write; it reads them every run so nothing's generic, and they grow (you're raising it) • ② memory — facts + your rules + how-to's; a skill is a memory • ③ a lane, not a task • ④ tools — MCP, ~1 min to connect • ⑤ a schedule — wakes on its own, pings you only for decisions • ⑥ guardrails — low-stakes it does; high-stakes it drafts and waits for your yes I run mine from a Google Sheet — it drafts every reply in my voice, I approve in 10 minutes, every 30 minutes it sends the approved ones and learns from my revisions. The moat: anyone can buy the same AI. Nobody has your context. Come build it with me. #aiemployee #aiagent #aiautomation #professorglitch

Cozy season meal preps are back 🍂 One-Pot French Onion Chicken & Rice!! Full recipe below 🫶🏼 INGREDIENTS: - 2 tbsp butter - 2 large yellow onions, thinly sliced - 3 garlic cloves, minced - 1 cup uncooked long-grain white rice - 2 1/4 cups beef bone broth - 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce - 1 tsp dried thyme - 1/2 tsp garlic powder - Salt & pepper, to taste - White meat of 1 rotisserie chicken - Splash of half & half - 1 cup shredded Gruyère cheese, divided - Fresh thyme for topping, optional INSTRUCTIONS: Melt butter in a large deep skillet or pot over medium-low heat. Add sliced onions and cook for about 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden and caramelized. Then add garlic, thyme, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Cook for another minute until fragrant. Add the rice, beef bone broth and Worcestershire sauce. Stir well, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 18–20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed. While the rice cooks, shred the rotisserie chicken and grate the Gruyère cheese. Once the rice is cooked, stir in the shredded chicken and a splash of half & half. Stir in 1/4 cup of the Gruyère until melted and creamy. Sprinkle the remaining 3/4 cup Gruyère evenly over the top. Cover and cook for another 2–3 minutes until melted OR, if using an oven-safe skillet, place under the broiler for a few minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbly and slightly crispy on top. Keep a close eye on it so it doesn’t burn! Top with fresh thyme & enjoy! #mealprep #healthymealprep #easymealprep #onepotmeals #fallrecipes

THE ONE YOU’VE ALL BEEN WAITING FOR: COLLAGEN CHAT (Girl Science Edition) 🩷 First up, collagen is important. It’s what keeps your skin bouncy, joints cushioned, and tissues strong. Your body makes collagen, but rom your mid-20s, that production starts to dip – and drops faster post-menopause thanks to hormonal changes. DO YOU NEED TO TAKE A COLLAGEN SUPPLEMENT? Collagen supplements don’t “top up” your collagen directly. They’re broken down into small peptides that signal your body to make more, but only if your body’s in the right state to respond. That generally comes from you sleeping well, eating a balanced diet with enough protein and managing your stress, Without those foundations, the signal’s weak – and your collagen powder probably won’t do much. Where collagen actually delivers: 💞Joints: Hydrolysed or type II collagen can help reduce joint pain and slow cartilage breakdown (especially if osteoarthritis runs in your family). 🌟Skin: Evidence is mixed. High-quality, independent studies show minimal benefit for elasticity or hydration. 💅Hair & nails: Not much science here yet. Takehome message: collagen can support you, but it’s not a miracle. Focus on your foundations first – balanced nutrition, sleep, and stress management – and collagen becomes the cherry on top, not the whole sundae 🍒 #collagen #collagenforwomen #girlscience #womenshealth #hormonehealth

We tore up our own backyard to save over $4,000 and honestly… I’d do it again. 😅 This is Part 3 of our DIY paver patio series: the budget breakdown. We were quoted $6,000+ for a patio extension, so my husband and I decided to tackle this backyard renovation ourselves. Here’s what it actually cost: • Skid steer rental for excavation: $350 • Plate compactor rental: $75 • Landscaping fabric: $60 • Truckload of leveling sand: $350 • 350 sq ft of pavers (delivered): $935 • Polymeric sand for the paver joints: $90 • Edge restraints (that I hated): $130 • Miscellaneous DIY tools + concrete blade: $100 Total DIY patio cost: $2,090. After laying the pavers, we made all the edge cuts with an angle grinder and somehow managed to get the transition to our existing patio looking pretty dang professional. I even ditched the border bricks I bought and “shopped” my own backyard for free landscaping rocks instead. 😂 This DIY backyard makeover ended up being cheaper than the poured concrete quotes we received, but I love that paver patios add so much more character, texture, and curb appeal. Start by seasoning your thinly cut/butterflied chicken breast generously on each side with cajun seasoning, olive oil & mix well until each piece is fully coated. 2. Cook the chicken on medium - high heat for approximately 4 minutes on each side, once cooked set it aside. 3. Leave the chicken juice in the pan & cook diced brown onion, diced capsicum/bell peppers & diced garlic cloves until softened. 4. Add light butter to the middle of the pan with a bit of cajun seasoning & let the seasoning toast for approximately 1 minute, then add cooked white rice & mix well until fully incorporated. 5. To a seperate pan on medium heat add light butter with a bit more cajun seasoning, after about 1 minute add light evaporated milk with a bit more cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, grated parmesan cheese & mix until smooth & creamy. 6. Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers  2 large chicken breast  Neutral oil  1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp soy 1/2 tsp onion powder  1 tsp cornstarch  Sauce  Bell peppers, sliced (for sautéing) 1 tsp ginger paste or grated  2 tbsp garlic paste  2 tbsp honey  1/4 cup light and dark soy combined  1 tsp rice seasoning  1 tbsp hoisin sauce  1/2 tbsp oyster sauce  1/2 tsp Totole Granulated Chicken Flavor Season the chicken with neutral oil, seasonings, and cornstarch. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Cook the chicken in a skillet 2–3 minutes per side until lightly browned, then remove and set aside. In the same pan, sauté the sliced peppers until they reach your desired texture, then add the garlic paste. Pour in the sauce and simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. If needed, add a 1:1 cornstarch slurry to thicken. Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together until coated. Garnish with sliced green onions and enjoy #Foodie #cooking #food #honeygarlicchicken #chicken

Recipe Name: Creamy Spinach Mushroom Chicken Bake Ingredients 1. 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 1 tsp salt 4. 1 tsp black pepper 5. 1 tsp garlic powder 6. 8 oz mushrooms, sliced 7. 3 cups fresh spinach 8. 4 cloves garlic, minced 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded 12. 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, grated 13. 1 tbsp butter 14. 1 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Season chicken with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. 3. Sear chicken in olive oil until golden on both sides. 4. Transfer chicken to a baking dish. 5. Melt butter in the skillet and sauté mushrooms until browned. 6. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. 7. Stir in chicken broth and heavy cream. 8. Simmer for 3 minutes. 9. Add spinach and cook until wilted. 10. Pour sauce over chicken. 11. Top with mozzarella and Parmesan. 12. Bake 20–25 minutes until bubbly. 13. Broil 2 minutes for a golden top. 14. Garnish with parsley and serve. 👉 Follow our account for more delicious recipes every day!

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

Honey Crispy Chicken Ingredients 	•	2 lbs chicken breasts, cubed 	•	2 eggs, beaten 	•	1 ½ cups cornstarch 	•	2 Tbsp soy sauce 	•	½ tsp black pepper 	•	¼ cup brown sugar 	•	¾ cup butter 	•	3–4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	¼ tsp red pepper flakes 	•	¼ cup soy sauce 	•	½ cup honey 	•	1 Tbsp water 	•	1 Tbsp cornstarch (for slurry) 	•	Vegetable oil, for frying 	•	Steamed white rice, for serving ⸻ Instructions 	1.	Prepare the Chicken: 	•	In a bowl, mix chicken cubes with eggs, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. 	•	Add cornstarch and toss until chicken is well coated. 	2.	Fry the Chicken: 	•	Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium-high heat. 	•	Fry chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. 	•	Remove and drain on paper towels. 	3.	Make the Honey Sauce: 	•	In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. 	•	Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté until fragrant. 	•	Stir in brown sugar, ¼ cup soy sauce, and honey. Bring to a gentle boil. 	•	Mix 1 Tbsp water with 1 Tbsp cornstarch in a small bowl to make a slurry. Whisk into the sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until thickened. 	4.	Combine & Serve: 	•	Add fried chicken to the sauce and toss until coated evenly. 	•	Serve hot over a bed of steamed white rice. #chicken #fyp #fypシ #viral #recipe

20 Minute Mediterranean Dinner 🇮🇹 Orata Acqua Pazza is a classic Southern Italian fish recipe. I first had it at a restaurant in Taormina, Sicily and I asked the chef how to make it. A light healthy fish dinner that tastes like the Mediterranean. The perfect easy weeknight seafood recipe.  You don't need a lot of time to make a healthy dinner for your family.  Recipe in the comments ⬇️ Orata Acqua Pazza Ingredients:  2 Orata (Sea Bream) filets 2 Yukon Gold potatoes, cubed Fresh mint Fresh basil 1 handful raisins 1 handful green olives 1 tablespoon capers 1/2  white onion, diced 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved Olive oil Salt and pepper to taste Directions:  1. Par boil the potatoes in salted water for about 10 minutes.  2. In a large frying pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add the cherry tomatoes, olives, capers, raisins, and onion. Saute until the onions are translucent. 3. Add the potatoes and 3/4 cup of the hot potato water. Stir in the chopped basil and mint. 4. Nestle the fish into the pan. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and cook until the fish turns white and is cooked through. #mediterranean #easyrecipe #fyp

Claude just dropped Claude Motion, and you can now turn anything into an animated video. Here's how it works: 1. Type /motion, attach your file and tell Claude what you want. Sweet, savory, and packed with bold garlic flavor 🧄🍗 — this Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken is sticky, caramelized perfection and comes together fast! ⸻ 🍗 Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken ⭐ Ingredients 	•	4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (or thighs) 	•	Salt & black pepper 	•	1 tsp paprika 	•	2 tbsp olive oil Garlic Brown Sugar Sauce: 	•	½ cup packed brown sugar 	•	4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	2 tbsp soy sauce 	•	1 tbsp Dijon mustard (optional, for depth) 	•	1 tbsp apple cider vinegar or lemon juice 	•	½ tsp crushed red pepper (optional) ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Directions 	1.	Season chicken: Pat chicken dry and season both sides with salt, pepper, and paprika. 	2.	Sear: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown. 	3.	Make sauce: In a bowl, whisk together brown sugar, garlic, soy sauce, mustard, vinegar, and red pepper flakes. 	4.	Simmer: Reduce heat to medium-low. Pour sauce into skillet. Spoon sauce over chicken and simmer 5–7 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through. 	5.	Serve: Spoon extra caramelized garlic sauce over top before serving. ⸻ 🍽️ Serve With 	•	White or jasmine rice 	•	Roasted broccoli 	•	Mashed potatoes ⸻ ✨ Tips 	•	Chicken thighs stay extra juicy 	•	For thicker sauce, simmer a few extra minutes 	•	Add a splash of pineapple juice for a sweet tropical twist Sticky, garlicky, and perfectly sweet — a guaranteed weeknight favorite 💛 #foodie #foodtok #recipe #dinner #chicken

Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe

videos.caption: Cozy & Affordable Baked Chicken Dinner 🍗🤎 Tonight I was going for cozy, comforting, and affordable, and this is one of my go-to dinners when I want something simple but still really good. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner. You already know this Cowboy Mashed Potato Casserole is gonna be GOOD! 🤠 To get the recipe, click the link in @allrecipes bio or continue reading! ⬇️ Ingredients: cooking spray 6 strips bacon 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and chopped 1 (5 ounce) can evaporated milk or whole milk 2 tablespoons butter 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, divided 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, divided 1 pound ground beef 1 cup chopped onion 1 green bell pepper, chopped 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1/4 cup barbecue sauce 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar or pepper Jack cheese 1/4 cup canned French fried onions 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley Directions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place dish on a baking sheet. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium, turning occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Place bacon on a paper towel to drain. Drain all but 1 Tbsp of bacon fat in the skillet. Chop bacon when cool enough to handle. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and return to a boil. Cook, covered, until potatoes are fork tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain potatoes. Return potatoes back to the pot along with evaporated milk, butter, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mash potatoes with a potato masher until smooth. Stir 1/4 c chopped bacon into mashed potatoes. Add ground beef, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet with reserved bacon fat. Cook over medium until meat is browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally, 8-10 minutes. Add corn kernels, garlic, and paprika to the skillet. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Stir in barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, remaining 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Spread ground beef mixture in prepared baking dish. Spread potatoes evenly over beef. Sprinkle with cheese, remaining bacon, and French fried onions. Bake until bubbly and cheese is melted, 20-25 minutes. Garnish with parsley. 👨‍🍳: Nicole McLaughlin #cowboycasserole #mashedpotatoes #easydinners #dinnerideas

Viral Bread recipe!  4 cups flour 2 cups warm water 2½ tsp yeast 1–2 tbsp salt Mix everything together. The dough will be sticky. Cover with a kitchen towel and let it sit for 2 hours. Transfer to a floured surface and knead/fold it 4–5 times. Cover and let it rise another 30 minutes. Place your Dutch oven in the oven and preheat to 450°F. Carefully remove the hot Dutch oven, place the dough on parchment paper and put it inside. Bake covered: 30 minutes Bake uncovered: 15 minutes That’s it. 🤯 The crust is SO good and the inside is soft and chewy.
